human_message: On Home, swipe through at least three featured movie tiles and then swipe back. Check that each tile has a readable title and description and that its artwork stays aligned with its text.
severity_reason: Featured-tile presentation affects discovery convenience while other browsing routes remain available.

human_message: After Home finishes loading, scroll through Recommended for you, Trending, Now Playing, Top Rated, and Upcoming. Check that each available section has a readable heading and its cards are visually separated from the next section.
severity_reason: Section headings and spacing are presentation issues with limited impact on core tasks.

human_message: Open the About or Credits information from Home, check that TMDB is identified as the movie-data provider, and return to the same Home screen.
severity_reason: Supporting provider information does not block finding or saving a movie.

human_message: Open a movie that has a provider rating and check that the rating source and scale are clear. Compare the rating on its card with its details, without assuming a fixed score or vote count.
severity_reason: This primarily checks supporting rating presentation rather than the main navigation or saved data.

human_message: Using a live movie known to have neither poster nor backdrop artwork, open its card and details. Check that a clear artwork placeholder appears and that the movie title remains readable.
severity_reason: A missing artwork fallback is a visual degradation when the movie remains identifiable.

human_message: Open a movie with a long overview and scroll through the description. Check that the available text wraps cleanly and is not covered by the bottom tab bar.
severity_reason: Secondary description layout affects readability without preventing the primary movie actions.

human_message: Go to Browse and switch between Now Playing, Upcoming, Popular, and Top Rated. Wait for each category to load and check that the selected category and page heading agree with the results being shown.
severity_reason: Category confusion disrupts a discovery workflow but other catalog routes can still work.

human_message: Choose a Browse category with more than one page of results. Scroll until another page loads, check that earlier cards remain and no movie is duplicated, then open a newly loaded movie and return to the listing.
severity_reason: Broken pagination prevents deeper browsing while first-page discovery remains usable.

human_message: In Search, enter "   Interstellar   " and pause. Check that it searches for the trimmed title. Then replace the query with spaces only and confirm that old results disappear and the normal empty-search state returns.
severity_reason: Incorrect normalization or clearing disrupts a recoverable search interaction.

human_message: Search for "zzzxqv987654321nomovie". If the live provider returns no matches, verify that the app shows a clear no-results message rather than a network error, then replace it with Interstellar and check that search still works.
severity_reason: Confusing no matches with a failure harms recovery from an ordinary unsuccessful search.

human_message: Search for Interstellar, scroll the results if necessary, and open the 2014 movie. Go back and confirm that the same query, loaded results, and useful scroll position are still there.
severity_reason: Losing search context adds repeated work but does not normally lose saved user data.

human_message: Open Interstellar from Search and inspect its details. Check that the title and 2014 release year identify the selected movie, and that the available runtime, genres, rating, and overview have readable labels.
severity_reason: Incomplete details reduce confidence in the selected title and impair movie evaluation.

human_message: Open Interstellar, open its cast list, and select a cast member shown there. Check that the person page identifies the person I selected and displays a biography or an honest unavailable message, then return to the original cast list.
severity_reason: A broken cast-to-person journey affects a substantial secondary exploration feature.

human_message: From a cast member's person page, open their filmography and select one of the listed movies. Verify that its details match the movie I selected, then go back to that person's filmography without losing the browsing context.
severity_reason: Incorrect filmography navigation breaks connected discovery while direct movie lookup remains available.

human_message: Starting from a movie, go through Cast, a Person, Filmography, another Movie, and an available Collection or Related Movies listing. Go back one screen at a time and check that each step returns along the exact path I followed.
severity_reason: Deep-stack corruption blocks connected exploration; path length alone does not make this a data-loss issue.

human_message: Use a live movie that has a Collection link. Open the collection, choose another listed movie, and verify that the collection and movie titles match the items I selected. Go back to the same collection and original movie.
severity_reason: Broken collection links impair a supported discovery journey without affecting all catalog access.

human_message: Open a movie with related titles, choose one of the related movies, and check that its details match that card. Return to the original movie and confirm that its title and related-movie section are still correct.
severity_reason: Wrong related-item routing damages discovery context but leaves other primary routes available.

human_message: Choose a live movie with images and reviews available. Open its image content and review content in turn, then return to details. Check that the content stays associated with that movie and that returning does not open a different title.
severity_reason: Rich-content navigation failures affect supported detail features and movie identity context.

human_message: Use a movie with an available trailer link, open that link, and check that it goes to a supported external destination. Return to Movies and confirm that I can continue from the same movie details.
severity_reason: An external-link or return-flow failure disrupts an optional media journey rather than the whole catalog.

human_message: Open a person's filmography through Home. Switch to Search, enter Interstellar, and open the 2014 movie. Switch back and forth between Home and Search and check that each tab keeps its own page, query, and Back path.
severity_reason: Mixing tab navigation contexts disrupts multiple exploration workflows but does not inherently erase favorites.

human_message: Launch Movies on an installation with a working live API configuration. Confirm that Home opens without a sign-in gate, all four tabs are usable, and I can open a real movie from a loaded discovery section.
severity_reason: A launch failure or blocked shell prevents access to the application's primary functions.

human_message: Search for Interstellar and open the result released in 2014. Verify that the details show Interstellar and 2014, and that favoriting it adds that same movie to Library rather than another result or similarly named title.
severity_reason: Saving the wrong entity corrupts the relationship between a core lookup and user-created favorites.

human_message: On a prepared slow live connection, search for Interstellar and wait until its API request has actually started but has not completed. Replace the query with Avatar. After both requests settle, verify that the displayed query and results belong to Avatar and that the late Interstellar response does not replace or relabel them.
severity_reason: Stale responses can associate results with the wrong request and mislead the main search workflow.

human_message: Start with Interstellar from 2014 not favorited. Add it to favorites, confirm it appears in Library, then close and relaunch Movies without reinstalling or clearing app data. Verify that the same movie is still saved exactly once.
severity_reason: Losing an acknowledged favorite after restart is loss of user-created data.

human_message: With Interstellar from 2014 already saved, remove it from Library and tap Undo within five seconds while the app stays active. Check that it returns exactly once, then close and relaunch Movies and verify the restored favorite is still present.
severity_reason: A failed Undo restoration can cause unintended permanent loss after the UI claims recovery.

human_message: Save Interstellar from 2014 and Life of Pi from 2012. Remove only Interstellar, let its Undo offer expire, and relaunch Movies. Verify that Interstellar remains removed while Life of Pi is still saved exactly once.
severity_reason: Removing unrelated favorites or reversing a saved removal violates saved-data integrity.

human_message: Favorite Interstellar from its Search details, then open that same movie through Library and any other available discovery or related-movie path. Verify that every occurrence shows the same saved state. Remove it from one path and check that the others and Library agree.
severity_reason: Conflicting favorite state across paths can cause users to save or remove the wrong persisted state.

human_message: After saving Interstellar and Life of Pi online, use the same installation with its internet connection unavailable. Open Library, verify both saved entries remain identifiable, remove Interstellar and undo that removal, then restore connectivity and relaunch. Confirm that both favorites remain saved exactly once.
severity_reason: A network outage must not erase or corrupt favorites that are stored locally.

human_message: On a device whose internet connection is unavailable, open a catalog destination whose request has no cached response. Verify a clear error with Retry rather than successful empty results or substituted demo movies. Restore connectivity, tap Retry, and confirm that real catalog content loads and the app becomes usable again.
severity_reason: Misrepresenting a service failure or failing to recover can make core catalog access unusable.

human_message: On a prepared test device that is already unable to save additional local data, try to favorite a movie that is not saved. Verify that the app reports the save failure, does not claim the movie was saved, and preserves all previously saved favorites.
severity_reason: A failed write that appears successful or damages existing favorites causes user-data loss or false persistence claims.

human_message: Switch the tabs to Home, Browse, Search, and Library.
severity_reason: Simple tabs switches.
